title: Sam Xie portfolio
lede: A software engineer’s portfolio on a pale gray gradient with a soft raised button and a white 3D bird.
summary: Personal portfolio: pale gray surface, a raised pill button, a raised panel, and a monochrome 3D render.

evidence.note: Captured with `tools/capture.mjs` (headless Chrome, 1440 × 900) on 28 September 2026 and inspected. The screenshot shows the first viewport; the measurement covers up to four screens.

styles.note: Borderline. The pale gray surface, the raised “Browse products” pill, and the raised panel below follow the style, but the first viewport is mostly type and a 3D render, and the shadows are small.

context: The site’s template is published as [samzx/soft-portfolio](https://github.com/samzx/soft-portfolio) (created 1 May 2020), described as “a neumorphic inspired website”.
observed: A pale gray page with a faint diagonal gradient. “Sam Xie” is set in a very large, bold, near-black sans-serif.
A “Browse products” pill in a lighter gray with a soft shadow is the only control.
A large white 3D render of a bird in flight fills the right half.
The top edge of a wide panel in a lighter gray with round corners rises from the bottom of the viewport.
interpretation: One of the few personal sites found that still use the style. The monochrome 3D bird matches the surface; the open-source template it derives from calls itself “a neumorphic inspired website”.
Measured: shadows on 71 % of boxes (median offset 4.5 px, median blur 4 px, none hard), borders on 0 %, median radius 20 px.
